provider: ServaRICA Polar Bear / Killer Whale / Mammoth storage

free_tier.stated: Opossum 1 1 TB $29/yr · Polar Bear 2 TB $5/mo or $48/yr · Killer Whale 3.5 TB $8.50/mo or $84/yr · Mammoth 8 TB $20/mo or $220/yr

egress.terms: Quoted as a hard monthly transfer figure per plan: 4 TB / 12 TB / 18 TB / 24 TB on a 1 Gbps port. So 2-3x storage per month. ServaRICA's separate 'unlimited' offer is a different product line: unlimited transfer starting at 250 Mbps and growing +1 Mbps/day up to 1 Gbps.

interface_detail: KVM/Xen + root, so anything: SFTP, rsync, NFS, rclone serve s3, MinIO, WebDAV via container
tooling: Root access makes this the most chainable option among the storage providers compared: AList, MinIO or a Cloudflare tunnel endpoint can run on the box itself.
chaining: Composition with external storage pools is unestablished.
limits_note: Bandwidth is a hard counter on these plans. Capacity grows 1 GB per day on the expanding plan series. Billing and ordering systems were offline during testing on 2026-10-21.
reliability_note: Canadian provider since 2010, RAIDZ2. Treat as a real but currently-wobbly vendor.

evidence.proved: the seven-plan storage table keeps the same sizes and monthly/yearly prices
evidence.quote: | Polar Bear Storage | 2 GB | 2 | 12TB 1Gbps | 2 TB | $5CA$6.75 | $48CA$64.80 | ... | Killer Whale Storage | 2 GB | 2 | 18TB 1Gbps | 3.5 TB | $8.50CA$11.48 | $84CA$113.40 | ... | Mammoth Storage | 8 GB | 4 | 24TB 1Gbps | 8 TB | $20CA$27 | $220CA$297 |

evidence.proved: two bandwidth options are offered: a speed-clamped unlimited transfer and a capped fast port
evidence.quote: Every VPS: (1) unlimited transfer starting at 250 Mbps, growing +1 Mbps/day to 1 Gbps; or (2) 10 Gbps port with a monthly transfer cap. Choose at checkout.

price_per_tb_month: $2.50/TB/mo at 2 TB ($5/mo) and at 8 TB ($20/mo); $2.43/TB/mo at 3.5 TB. On yearly: Polar Bear $48/yr = $2.00/TB/mo; Mammoth $220/yr = $2.29/TB/mo. at 5 TB: 8 TB plan at $2.50/TB/mo (or 3x Polar Bear at $2.00/TB/mo). at 20 TB: 2.5x Mammoth = $2.29/TB/mo. Caveat: active billing outage…
